text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Beijing Datang Power Co successfully listed on the London Stock Exchange on Monday, becoming the first Chinese firm to list in Britain. This will help European investors understand Chinese companies.

- Nine H-share companies, Chinese firms listed in Hong Kong, will continue to enjoy a 15 percent preferential tax rate in 1997, against 33 percent for other Chinese companies. They include Shanghai Petrochemical Co and Tsingtao Beer Co.
- Chinese brokerages are competing for specialised personnel, especially senior investment analysts.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Commentary urges foreign trade sector to focus on making money rather than obtaining foreign exchange at losses.
- Commentary urges more frequent fine tuning of bank interest rates rather than occasional drastic changes.
